description: Start a free Mishnayos learning page in memory of someone (for shloshim, a yahrzeit or another date). Family and friends open the public link and each take perakim. FREE, no account, no payment. Needs the organizer's OWN email: the private link for managing the page is emailed there and is never returned here, so never use another person's address. Confirm the names and spelling with the person BEFORE calling this. Returns the public page link to share.

ben_bas.description: "ben" (son of) or "bas" (daughter of). Needed only with father_hebrew_name.

father_hebrew_name.description: The father's Hebrew name as the family gave it, in Hebrew or English letters. Optional.

finish_by.description: Date to finish by, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: shloshim if date_of_passing is given and it is still ahead, else 30 days from today.

hebrew_name.description: Their Hebrew name exactly as the family gave it, in Hebrew or English letters, e.g. "משה" or "Moshe". Never guess or transliterate it. Required by the page; the "letters" mode needs Hebrew letters.

name.description: The name of the person being remembered, in English, e.g. "Moshe Cohen".

organizer_email.description: The organizer's own email. The private manage link is emailed here only.

organizer_name.description: The name of the person setting up the page (the one asking you).

passed_after_sunset.description: True if the passing was after sunset (the Hebrew date is the next day).

what_to_learn.description: all_of_shas: all of Mishnayos, 523 perakim. letters_of_name: one perek per letter of the Hebrew name, then נשמה. Default all_of_shas.

name: start_mishnayos_page
title: Start a free Mishnayos page
